name: After I’m Gone
tagline: Keeps a current roadmap ready for whoever settles your estate
description: Creates and maintains a practical roadmap for the person who would have to step in if you died or became incapacitated: who to contact, where each document lives, care arrangements, insurance, money and account access. Passwords are deliberately kept out of the conversation entirely.
author: scgerber
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
